targets.name: neon-jaytibirthday-db
targets.notes: Postgres warehouse for analytics and telemetry (D-9). REPRECED 2026-10-27 (D-36): the production warehouse is the meadow mirror project bitter-glade-72523152 ('jaytibirthday-db') of organization org-billowing-meadow-62228264, branch br-hidden-leaf-b8l1j76r ('main'), endpoint ep-holy-silence-b88j1f4i, database jpbir_live - the database name is part of the target and was preserved. This is where production writes and reads: the deployed console's 40 current section records and 15 sync states live there, and the post-release read-back at 2026-10-27T16:00:52Z was taken there. The Vercel branch is protected as a production branch (delete and endpoint-move actions are refused by Neon with reason 'vercel production branch'). The three application-facing branch databases of the same project are neondb on main (endpoint ep-holy-silence-b88j1f4i), neondb on birthday-isolated-20261010 (branch br-winter-salad-b82mip7n, endpoint ep-bitter-cell-b8tv0g1m) and neondb on dashboard-isolated-20261010 (branch br-curly-mode-b8354j8j, endpoint ep-spring-dust-b8tnhvt5) - the owner's approved application mapping is channel-sandbox to main/neondb and jaytibirthday-site to birthday-isolated-20261010/neondb. The move from org-cold-lake-91548510 was a migration, not an organization transfer: both organizations are Vercel-managed (managed_by=vercel) and Neon cannot transfer projects into or out of such an organization (D-35). Ten of the eleven source databases were reproduced exactly, verified with exact counts over the direct endpoint; globaldevices-db/main differs by one row, the mirror being the later snapshot.

targets.name: neon-consolidated-copy

resource_ids.databases: jpbir_live, trainingdata, globaldevices, aqua_ferry, privatefilegate, jtagent_agent, neondb, txt_file_db

targets.notes: The consolidated migration target recorded in D-35, and the project the repository's four connection secrets (DATABASE_URL, DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED, POSTGRES_URL, POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING, repointed 2026-10-27T14:46Z) still name until the owner runs the repoint. It holds jpbir_live with the same 37 tables and the same 15,748 events as the production mirror, and it is the only database in either organization still receiving writes (newest events.ingested_at 2026-10-27T08:11:17.866919Z), but it holds no console section records, so production reads the mirror instead (D-36). Two of its databases are empty: neondb has no tables at all and txt_file_db holds a documents table with zero rows - both artifacts of the restore behind D-35, whose cause is that Neon's dumps are PG16-format archives that pg_restore 16 refuses ('unsupported version (1.16) in file header') and that read with postgres:18. The five satellite databases (trainingdata 35,110, globaldevices 2, aqua_ferry 0, privatefilegate 0, jtagent_agent 0) duplicate the mirror's. The owner approved the repoint of the four secrets at the mirror (project/approvals/2026-10-27-neon-estate-decisions.md, question 1) and decided that the two empty databases are kept rather than dropped or filled (D-37), which leaves this project an inert duplicate; the whole project can still be dropped later on a separate approval.

targets.name: jp-agent-render
targets.notes: The jp-agent runtime behind jaytipargal.tech, verified live 2026-10-19. Vercel reaches it through JP_AGENT_URL (Backend/agent-run.js). Deployed from git; render.yaml declares the service shape, and no deploy script, ssh path, systemd unit or nginx config exists in this repository. DNS: runner.jaytipargal.tech and jp-agent.onrender.com both resolve to gcp-us-west1-1.origin.onrender.com via Cloudflare, TLS CN=runner.jaytipargal.tech valid to 2027-01-17. GET /health -> 200 {ok:true,service:"jp-agent",mcp:"in-process"}; /sessions -> 401 without a bearer token. "mcp":"in-process" means the standalone s24-mcp server is not in use and the tools are served in-process from s24-tools.mjs.
